# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: the bones of a walking player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_legs), one client joined allies with the
# m1carbine_mp. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 6 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=30701 PROBE_SECS=75 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_legs mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:30701 --probe-team allies --save-legs --probe-secs 70
# probe_legs.gsc puts the player on the street at (932, -376, -151.875) at level time
# 25000 and links script_origins to bip01 l foot, bip01 r foot, tag_weapon_right and
# bip01 head with zero offsets; the client half (-legs-client.txt) is the walk it did
# from there. This file is the server half, games_mp.log's PROBE lines, per server frame:
#   PROBE f <time> <player origin> <l foot origin> <l foot angles> <r foot origin> <r foot angles>
#   PROBE h <time> <hand origin> <hand angles> <head origin> <head angles>
# The log ends where the client disconnected. docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 15,
# "A moving body's clip", is what it measured.
